Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.games.chess

package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.games.chess
  • Class
    Description
    Chess3D
    A native 3D chess game: the human plays White against a negamax + alpha-beta engine (ChessModel).
    ChessModel
    A complete chess engine: legal move generation (including castling, en passant and promotion), check / checkmate / stalemate / insufficient-material detection, and a negamax + alpha-beta opponent with a quiescence search and the standard simplified-evaluation piece-square tables.
    ChessModel.Move
    A move; promo is a piece type (or 0), captured the victim.
    ChessModel.Pos
    A position: board, side to move, castling rights and ep target.
    ChessPanel
    The 2D/Swing counterpart of the native-3D Chess3D.
    ChessView
    The chess board, rasterised into a single live texture with the same ImageComponent2D.set recipe as AgendaGrid / MailView.
    ChessView.SquareListener
    Notified with the 0..63 model-space square index of a left click.
